test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-II Exam 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov, 2024).
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate article(s) to fill in the blanks.

I was in ________ state of unconsciousness for about half ________ hour
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 3'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence requires an article before "state" and "hour".
 
• The article "a" is used before "state" because it is a singular, countable noun.
 
• The article "an" is used before "hour" because "hour" starts with a vowel sound.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"I was in **a** state of unconsciousness for about half **an **hour."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "the ; a"** is incorrect because "the" is not appropriate before "state" in this context.
 
• **Option 2: "a ; No article"** is incorrect because "an" is necessary before "hour".
 
• **Option 4: "No article ; an"** is incorrect because "a" is necessary before "state".
